name: Plastic Design & Manufacturing
old_description: PDM was founded in 1998 as a full-service consulting company developing turn key manufacturing programs for the sporting, industrial, and automotive markets.  The success of these programs led to the creation of our factory direct sourcing for tooling and eventually plastic parts and assemblies from our custom built factory in 2009 located in beautiful southwest Montana.  Our growth continues with molding operations in Juarez Mexico, and Shenzhen China for production tooling and sourcing.
about:
Plastic Design & Manufacturing (PDM Plastics) was founded in 1998 in Manhattan, Montana, as a full-service consulting firm developing turnkey manufacturing programs for the sporting, industrial, and automotive markets. The company transitioned to direct manufacturing in 2009 with a custom-built factory in southwest Montana, and later expanded to molding operations in Juárez, Mexico, and Shenzhen, China, for production tooling and sourcing.

Today PDM operates two primary production plants—its headquarters in Manhattan, Montana, and a facility in Juárez, Mexico—running 22 injection molding machines ranging from 50 to 1,400 tons. The company provides custom injection molding, tooling design and build, assembly, packaging, decoration, design assistance, prototyping, and secondary operations, serving high- to medium-volume plastic component needs.

PDM serves a diverse industrial base including automotive, electronics, medical, industrial equipment, sporting goods and firearms, pet products, agricultural, construction, consumer goods, and battery components. Customers range from OEMs requiring safety-critical automotive parts to brands seeking consumer-grade plastic assemblies.

The company emphasizes low-overhead, non-union facilities operating 24 hours a day, five to seven days a week, with global sourcing capabilities. It highlights value engineering, contract pricing on materials, and a preference for recycled and bio-based resins where applicable, alongside environmentally sound manufacturing practices.
